messages:
ana: did a quick pass on the Quickstart for a UX audit — found three tiny friction points: the minimal hello app README still references `REDWOOD_KEY`, the quickstart's SDK examples mix "generate" and "chat" shapes which confuses users, and the 'deploy' link in the sidebar points to /deploy-checklist (404). opening a thread to batch a minimal fix set.

mike: can you paste the snippets/lines you saw? i'll take the README + sidebar link.

ana: README excerpt: ```md
export REDWOOD_KEY=abc123
npm start
```
quickstart snippet shows both:```js
// one place
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'Hi' })
// another place
const msg = await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hi' }] })
```
recommendations: use RW_API_KEY everywhere, standardize examples to chat, and update sidebar link to /quickstart/deploy.

zhou: i'll standardize the JS snippets to chat.create and add a 1-line migration note: "If you used older examples that call generate(), see migration guide." i'll open a PR for snippets.

tara: i'll sweep the repo for REDWOOD_KEY/OLD_KEY and update the README and starter links to point to github.com/redwood-inference/starter-apps. also will change the sidebar link. PR will include link-check and mdlint fixes.

docs-bot: created issue #520: "quickstart: unify examples to chat, env var rename, deploy link" assigned to zhou and tara.

zhou: PR #3410 opened: replaces generate() usages in quickstart examples with chat.create, adds short migration callout, and updates the inline JS snippet to use 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const r = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/fast', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
console.log(r.output)
```
added a one-liner: "Tip: prefer RW_API_KEY in CI or secrets manager."

tara: PR #3411 opened: repo sweep for REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY, README fix in starter examples, and sidebar link change. also updated the deploy sidebar to use relative path /quickstart/deploy.

ci-bot: PR #3410 lint ok. PR #3411 link-check found one stale absolute docs URL in community/README — fixed in same PR.

mike: quick copy nit in #3410: change "migration note" heading to "Upgrading from older examples". small push sent.

zhou: pushed copy nit. thanks.

docs-bot: both PRs have passed checks and are ready to merge.

mike: merging both now. after merge can we trigger a docs refresh so the broken link stops 404ing?

tara: will trigger a small site roll after merge; monitoring link-check.

docs-bot: PR #3410 merged by zhou. PR #3411 merged by tara. Deploy job queued.

ci-bot: docs deploy succeeded. staging quickstart: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (staging) — deploy link resolves, snippets show chat.create, RW_API_KEY used consistently.

ana: spot-checked the quickstart and starter README; things look consistent. thanks for the quick turnaround. resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
